'''SE4-12''' was a modified [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[SE4 servant droid]]. In the aftermath of [[Qual'om Soach]]'s attack on the [[Nalmar Family|Nalmar crime family]], [[Eelien Kirat]] decided that protection was required for his top lieutenants. SE4-12, alongside [[SE4-10]], were modified to serve as camouflaged [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] for Kirat and [[Elana Nalmar]]. SE4-12 performed their regular duties in addition to being bodyguards. In an emergency, SE4-12 could deploy a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] hidden in the left arm, which fired from the palm of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] hand.<ref name="FBS" />
